console.title: DeviceCare · Operator console
console.settingsIntro: Outbound email for staff invitations and other organisation mail.
console.customersIntro: Each institution is its own tenant. Organisation-level access comes from a valid management contract, not from a clinic role.
console.customersEmpty: No service contracts for this organisation yet.
console.customersNote: Without a valid contract there is no organisation-level access. The tenant remains but disappears from the live list — rights do not have to be revoked individually.
console.createIntro: Organisation, tenant, first site and contract are created in one step. A tenant without a contract would be invisible to you.
console.createdInvite: Customer created. Superadmin invite sent to {email}.
console.createdInviteSimulated: Customer created. Superadmin invite for {email} was simulated (no SMTP).
console.detailInstitutionNote: Without an address and a contact there is no source of truth for the account.
console.detailModelHint: Under this operating model, access ends with the contract rather than by unilateral suspension alone.
console.detailAccessBanner: Access ends with the contract. All staff assignments to this tenant become ineffective — they need not be revoked individually, nor do they revive under a new contract.
console.detailStaffIntro: Who from your organisation may work in this tenant. The assignment requires a valid contract — without one, row-level security does not grant access anyway.
console.detailStaffEmpty: No partner staff in this organisation yet.
console.staffRevoked: Staff access revoked for this customer.
console.detailAssignmentsEmpty: No service requests in this tenant yet.
console.detailAssignmentsNote: Scheduled here, performed elsewhere. The inspection itself runs in the contracted company's portal — in your own organisation's service partner portal when performed in house, in the provider's when outsourced. This console shows the state; it does not perform the work.
console.contractEndNote: Ended or terminated contracts leave the live list; the tenant remains.
console.dueDatesIntro: Open duties on devices in institutions you manage. Disposition only — no inspection execution here.
console.dueDatesEmpty: No open due dates on managed tenants.
console.staffIntro: Partner users of your organisation. Access to a clinic still requires a live management contract.
console.staffEmpty: No organisation members or open invitations yet.
console.staffNote: A qualification does not grant system access by itself — assignments and role do.
console.staffCreateIntro: Enter details and send an invitation. The person stays invited until they accept.
console.staffCreateInviteNote: Until the invite is accepted, this person appears as Invited and is not active.
console.staffEmailHint: Required — used as identity subject and invite address.
console.staffDispatchOriginHint: Dispatching computes distance from this point, not from a nameless postal code.
console.staffOriginPostal: Postal code of the starting point
console.staffRadiusHint: Beyond this radius the person ranks lower in dispatching. Distance is estimated from the postal code range — not travel time.
console.staffSkillLevelHint: Only manufacturer training is evidence towards third parties; the other two levels are management's assessment.
console.staffInvitedDetailNote: This person has not accepted the invitation yet. Profile, skills, and tenant assignment become editable after they join.
console.staffQualFootnote: Radiation-protection expertise may require additional evidence under StrlSchG — record the proof in Evidence.
console.staffEndedContractsNote: Ended contracts stay visible but cannot be assigned.
console.auditIntro: Organisation-scoped protocol of managing-org and related actions.
console.auditEmpty: No audit events for this organisation yet.
console.orgIntro: As a service company you manage tenants and see their inventory. As an inspection partner you perform inspections — including for institutions you do not manage.
console.orgPeopleEmpty: No active partner people are assigned.
console.orgClinicsEmpty: No active service contracts for this organisation.
console.orgDualRoleNote: The same organisation, two roles: service provider and inspection partner.
console.orgSperreBody: People, instruction and training records belong to the institution — even when you operate the platform for them. Those tables stay closed to the managing organisation.
console.dispositionIntro: Scheduling across the managed tenants. The work itself is done in the service partner portal, not here.
console.dispositionNoteLifecycleTitle: The case does not end with the appointment.
console.dispositionNoteLifecycleBody: Captured, assigned, scheduled, in progress, completed, billable — only the last turns a service into an invoice. Completion is recorded in the service partner portal, not here.
console.dispositionNoteRolesTitle: Contractor and handler are two fields.
console.dispositionNoteRolesBody: The organisation carries the assignment; the person performs it. A single field could not tell whether the job went to another company or to a colleague.
console.mySitesIntro: The institutions with inspections assigned to you — not the assignment list of every customer. You open an institution and work on a device.
console.mySitesEmpty: No inspections in the selected slice. Reset filters or set responsibility to all colleagues.
console.mySitesSummaryNote: A trip pays off when several inspections come together in one place — which is why the row is the institution, not the assignment.
console.sitePortalVerifyHint: Matches the code against your assignments. A UDI-DI alone is not enough — it identifies the model, not the individual device.
console.sitePortalSelectLater: Hand-off scoping comes in a later step — selection is kept for now.
console.assignmentsIntro: Orders where your organisation is the executor — including institutions without a management contract.
console.assignmentsEmpty: No inspection orders for your organisation.
console.staffAssignIntro: Which managed tenants this person may open. Admins see all live contracts.
console.staffAssignAdminNote: Administrators may open every live customer; no per-tenant list is needed.
console.externalIntro: Inspectors from outside organisations commissioned by you. They work in the partner access on assigned jobs only.
console.externalCreateIntro: Commission an outside inspector and send a partner access invite.
console.externalCreateInviteNote: Until the invite is accepted, this person appears as Invited and is not deployable.
console.externalEmailHint: The invitation to the service-partner access goes to this address. Access applies to the allocated assignments and ends with the commission.
console.externalLiabilityHint: Both are mandatory. An expired record removes the person from every assignment — an inspection by an uninsured external inspector falls back on the operator in a claim.
console.externalDeploymentHint: For an outside organisation the starting point is its registered office, not the person's home.
console.externalNotDeployableNote: These people appear in no assignment until the commission and the liability cover are valid again.
console.externalWorkflowNote: How an inspection runs: the item is assigned by due date; a person is chosen by qualification, current commission and liability cover; an appointment is set; execution happens in service-partner access (only assigned jobs); completion produces follow-up dates and makes the item billable.
console.externalSkillEmpty: No skill recorded. The person can be assigned once the qualification is in order — dispatching will then point out that they do not know the device.
console.fieldContactEmailHint: Mandatory. An invitation as clinic superadmin is sent to this address.
console.fieldMpsbHint: § 6 MPBetreibV. Leaving it open is permitted — the customer then appears in the list with an open item.
console.fieldPostalCodeHint: Mandatory. The proximity filter in dispatching computes on it — without it the customer appears far away for every member of staff.
console.fieldAvvHint: Mandatory under this operating model: you process the institution's personal data on its behalf. The record under Article 28 GDPR belongs in the customer file, not in a folder beside it.

settings.smtpIntroPartner: Used for staff invitations and other organisation mail. If unset, the platform SMTP fallback applies (or mail is simulated locally).
settings.smtpPasswordKeep: Leave blank to keep current password
settings.smtpAskSuperadmin: Ask a Superadmin to configure SMTP.

management.title: Management
management.noContract: No active service contract for this clinic. Partner organisations cannot open this tenant until a contract is recorded.
management.staffExcluded: Staff data and training records are excluded from the managing organisation's access — regardless of the scope of services and regardless of the operating model.
management.operatingCallout: The platform is operated by the service company. Unilateral suspension is therefore not provided for — it would be a breach of contract in one click. An objection records your concerns and surfaces at the provider.
management.noPeople: No active partner people are assigned to this organisation.
management.peopleFootnote: From the service company's assignment. You cannot change it here — but you can see at any time who it is.
management.latestAccessBody: Access in the capacity of managing organisation is not recorded in this POC yet. When the audit trail is connected, only partner-scoped actions will appear here — otherwise a provider's access could not be separated from your own.

clarifications.openCasesHint: Devices with at least one issue
clarifications.empty: No clarification items — inventory records look complete.
clarifications.footer: Fix missing fields and duplicates here or in Inventory. Classification quality is maintained on the linked catalog model.

registration.title: Initial registration of a medical device
registration.subtitle: Regulatory intake under MPBetreibV and StrlSchV. The wizard derives the duties from the characteristics but does not decide: every duty carries its basis and its confidence level, and no answer removes a duty from the list — it marks it as not applicable, visibly and with a reason.
registration.name: Name *
registration.kindQuestion: What kind of device is this?
registration.kindLead: Your selection shows the characteristics that apply to this kind. Everything else remains available under “Further characteristics”.
registration.originManufacturer: from the manufacturer's instructions for use
registration.intervalJustificationPlaceholder: Why this interval — intensity of use, experience, missing manufacturer specification
registration.intervalJustificationHint: A self-set interval without justification cannot be defended in an inspection.
registration.protocolLead: Every duty-triggering answer with origin, responsible person, and time (FA-217).
registration.dutiesAlert: Deadline anchors differ: STK month-end, MTK year-end, maintenance exact day.
registration.readyMessage: All mandatory prerequisites confirmed. Release creates the device record and service plan.
registration.reclassifyConfirm: All inventory copies linked to this model will be updated.
registration.reclassifyReady: All mandatory prerequisites confirmed. Applying will re-freeze duties on every released copy of this model.

registration.summaryNote: The device kind proposes; it does not decide. Whoever confirms the entries is accountable for them — name and time are recorded on release.
registration.mtkIndependent: Maintenance and metrological control are independent duties with their own legal basis and deadline anchor. Different intervals are not a contradiction.
registration.zubehoerHint: E.g. ultrasound probes — classification follows the accessory, not only the system.
registration.furtherHint: Outside this device kind — only with a reason
registration.verfahrenHint: The ordinance distinguishes cases here. Without this answer the interval cannot be determined.
